sentences.text:
Smt. Bokul Majumder & Others vs The State Of West Bengal &
Another on 19 April, 2023
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
19.04.2023 In The High Court At Calcutta Item No.34 Criminal Revisional
Jurisdiction Ct.No.34 dc.
C.R.R. 1691 of 2021 Smt. Bokul Majumder & others versus The State of West Bengal & another In
Re: An Application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
Mr. Arijit Ganguly, Ms. Debjani Sahu ... For the State.

This revisional application was preferred challenging the FIR of Dum Dum Police Station Case No.
831 of 2021 dated 01.08.2021 under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

The contentions advanced in the present revisional application were to the effect that the petitioners have been unnecessarily implicated in the instant case, to substantiate the same, several factual circumstances have been narrated in this revisional application.
As none appears on behalf of the State, Ms. Debjani Sahu, learned advocate, who ordinarily appears for the State, is directed to represent the State.
Her appointment may be regularized by the concerned authorities.

Having considered the contentions advanced in the present revisional application, I am of the opinion that the same are absolutely question of facts for consideration of the learned trial court when the evidence would be in progress.
No interference is called for in respect of the proceedings relating to Dum Dum Police Station Case No. 831 of 2021 dated 01.08.2021.
Accordingly, the revisional application being CRR 1691 of 2021 is dismissed.
Pending connected applications, if any, are consequently disposed of.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.
